# Agreed scope: "more secure links, better marketing analytics"

Decided by a human in open-questions.md:

- Security means screening target URLs against a denylist at creation (Q1 = A).
- Better analytics means a CSV export of click events for a date range (Q2 = B).
- No new visitor data is stored; only the IP hash (Q3 = A).

Out of scope for now: API keys, longer codes, country or UTM breakdowns.

Implementation tasks are listed in the approved design; they will run as a brownfield change.
